app.title: SpeedCrunch 1.1
app.author: LordNibbler
app.description: Cross‑platform scientific calculator with a Qt UI, keyboard‑first design, and extensive unit support.
proposed_tests: Download the latest release for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
Verify that the executable launches and the main window appears.
Execute a set of predefined mathematical expressions and compare results against expected values.
Measure startup time and memory usage for each platform.
Confirm that the keyboard shortcuts for basic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide) work as documented.
